propositions.statement_en: Ibn Kathir reports that many Quran readers inferred from the preceding report that this surah is Medinan.
propositions.supporting_span: وَقَدِ اسْتَدَلَّ بِهِ كَثِيرٌ مِنَ الْقُرَّاءِ عَلَى أَنَّ هَذِهِ السُّورَةَ مَدَنِيَّةٌ،

propositions.statement_en: Ibn Kathir reports that many jurists inferred from the preceding report that the basmala is part of the surah and was revealed with it.
propositions.supporting_span: وَكَثِيرٌ مِنَ الْفُقَهَاءِ عَلَى أَنَّ الْبَسْمَلَةَ مِنَ السُّورَةِ، وَأَنَّهَا مُنَزَّلَةٌ مَعَهَا.

links.semantic_link_note: Supports only the inference attributed to many Quran readers (unnamed). Anonymous group label and scope are retained in the proposition statement; this is not Anas's speech or a claim of independent historical verification.

catalog_review.method: Fresh read-only SELECT * FROM public.claim_types ORDER BY id

selected.description: A narrator's report that someone said something, without full direct quotation.

catalog_review.reason: Each proposition explicitly reports an unnamed group's inference. reported_speech describes attribution without presenting the inferred conclusion as established fact. No direct quotation or legal obligation invented.

decisions: Each child has its own proposition_ref, so anonymous NULL-name voice rows remain associated with the correct statement and evidence.
unattributed_assertion is the available coarse evidence category; summaries and links explicitly preserve reported anonymous groups and inferential character.
assertion_mode=explicit describes the explicit report of inference, not endorsement of the inferred conclusion.
No hadith transmission routes: this paragraph is commentary about inference from a preceding report.
Jurist clause inherits استدل به from the first clause. The source excerpt remains exact; supplied predicate appears only in controlled translation annotations.
No physical IDs generated; symbolic staging keys and source_locator are staging metadata, not DB columns.
Both children require schema projection and source verification; no integration or count changes performed.

fidelity.limit: English chapter heading mentions Medina/Mecca and the basmala is printed, but these are not translations of the two attributed inference clauses. No global edition absence asserted.

source.offset_convention: zero-based Unicode codepoint half-open; trailing comma/space belongs to reader clause

clause_annotations.controlled_translation: Many Quran readers have inferred from it that this surah is Medinan.
And many jurists [have inferred from it] that the basmala is part of the surah and was revealed with it.
clause_annotations.ellipsis_note: Bracketed predicate is supplied from the opening استدل به; second clause is syntactically coordinated, not an independently complete literal quotation.

next_step: Add read-only validator for two-child refs, disjoint clause scopes, exact hashes, NULL anonymous names, absence fidelity and zero routes; audit multi-proposition consumer support before preview.
